# Hanyu Wang

> Hanyu Wang (GitHub: Nozidoali) is a PhD student in Computer Science at UCLA, advised by Prof. Jason Cong in the VAST research group. He works on mathematical optimization problems in electronic design automation (EDA): quantum circuit synthesis and compilation, logic synthesis, high-level synthesis (HLS), and LLM agents for hardware design-space exploration.

Background: MSc in Electrical Engineering and Information Technology from ETH Zurich (DYNAMO group, Prof. Lana Josipović; research at EPFL Integrated Systems Laboratory with Prof. Giovanni De Micheli); BEng from the UM-SJTU Joint Institute, Shanghai Jiao Tong University (logic synthesis with Prof. Weikang Qian).

Contact: hanyuwang@g.ucla.edu

## Selected publications

- Quantum Circuit Synthesis Using an Exact T Library. DAC 2026. arXiv:2605.15476
- Logical Resource Estimation for Quantum State Preparation with Compilation. DAC 2026. arXiv:2605.18877
- LLM-DSE: Searching Accelerator Parameters with LLM Agents. arXiv:2505.12188 (2025)
- Quantum State Preparation Circuit Optimization Exploiting Don't Cares. ICCAD 2024
- Quantum State Preparation Using an Exact CNOT Synthesis Formulation. DATE 2024. arXiv:2401.01009
- MapBuf: Simultaneous Technology Mapping and Buffer Insertion for HLS Performance Optimization. ICCAD 2023 (Best Paper Award nominee)
- Distilling Arbitration Logic from Traces using Machine Learning. DAC 2021 (Best Paper Award nominee)

## Open-source projects

- MiniFlash: fast Clifford+T to lattice-surgery compiler — https://github.com/Nozidoali/MiniFlash
- quantum-xyz / exact-xyz: quantum state preparation synthesis — https://github.com/Nozidoali/quantum-xyz
- LLM-DSE: LLM agents for accelerator design-space exploration — https://github.com/Nozidoali/LLM-DSE
- MapBuf: technology mapping + buffer insertion in Dynamatic HLS — https://github.com/Nozidoali/MapBuf
- Cost-generic resubstitution in mockturtle (EPFL logic synthesis library)
